checks.description: Optional subset of local toolchain checks. Defaults to the standard core checks: vasp, qe, lammps, conda, and python. Pass elk, openfoam, gpu, wannier90, gw, orca, or thermocalc explicitly when needed.

tools.description: Compatibility alias for checks. Prefer checks in new calls.

toolchainRoot.description: Optional container-visible toolchain root override. Defaults to MATOS_EXTERNAL_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT, MATOS_CONTAINER_TOOLCHAIN_ROOT, MATOS_COMPUTE_TOOLCHAIN_CONTAINER_ROOT, then /opt/matos-tools.

timeoutSeconds.description: Per-command timeout for non-expensive help/version checks. Defaults to 20 seconds because QE, pw2wannier90.x, and ABINIT startup probes can take several seconds on shared storage.

detail.description: Return compact tool status only with summary, or include detailed diagnostics and runtime library paths with full. Defaults to full for backward compatibility.

gpuIdleUtilizationMaxPercent.description: GPU utilization percentage at or below this threshold is considered idle for local routing.

gpuIdleMemoryUsedMiBMax.description: GPU memory used at or below this threshold is considered idle for local routing.
